works.title: The Orinoco Pyre
works.description: A geopolitical prediction and analysis article examining the logistics and consequences of Trump administration oil seizure from Venezuela, Chinese strategic response, rare earth supply chain vulnerabilities, and the 'Digital Ploesti' strategic parallel. Drafted as a Substack article under the pen name 'malcolmlittleking', with focus on how external military/economic adventurism masks internal policy failures.
works.quote: By framing it as a 'Pyre,' you're suggesting that the destruction isn't just a byproduct of war, but a deliberate statement by the colectivos: a symbolic burning of the wealth that the Trump administration has already claimed as its own.
